item.title: Kaleb Johnson: Could lead backfield again Week 10
item.description:
Johnson could serve as the Packers' lead option on the ground in Sunday's game against the Vikings with Josh Jacobs (finger) expected to miss multiple weeks and with the status of MarShawn Lloyd (knee) uncertain, Matt Schneidman of The Athletic reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Mike Evans: Not trending toward Week 10 return
item.description:
Evans (Achilles) isn't expected to be ready to play Sunday at Dallas, though the 49ers will continue to evaluate his status throughout the week, Brooke Evans of the team's official site reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Justin Herbert: Likely to play through finger injury
item.description:
Chargers head coach Jim Harbaugh said that Herbert "should be good to go" for Monday's game at Baltimore after imaging on the quarterback's injured left middle finger returned negative for a fracture, ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Rhamondre Stevenson: Likely to miss multiple weeks
item.description:
The knee injury that Stevenson sustained late in the third quarter of Sunday's 45-27 loss to the Packers is expected to keep him out for "the next few weeks," Ian Rapoport of NFL Network reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.

item.title: Brian Thomas: Staying put in Jacksonville
item.description:
The Jaguars have relayed to inquiring teams that they intend to keep Thomas through Tuesday's trade deadline, Jeremy Fowler of ESPN.com reports.
Visit RotoWire.com for more analysis on this update.
